name: logo-assemble
title: Logo Assemble
description: A single ring of image cards revolves around a centred title, then spins inward and drains to the middle — giving birth to a simple logo that slides left as the brand name reveals to its right.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/logos/logo-assemble?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
